name: Soo Wee
source:
Soo is a fashion designer who viral on TokTik not for her art or designs, but for eccentric, unfiltered personality. Which ultimately led to the rise of her own company. While still quite young, the arrow is pointing up. And [url=/c148291]MC[/url] might just be the golden ticket to the chocolate factory.
